Q00324_SweetestVenom/30351-06.html.text: Astaron: So you have brought me all ten Poison Sacs. Thank you. This should be enough to make three or four bottles of the finest Dreviant Wine. When the wine ages in a few years, I will let you sample it, so don't forget and come see me again. Now, here is the compensation I promised you.

Q00324_SweetestVenom/30351-05.html.text: Astaron: You agreed to collect ten Poison Sacs for me, right? Have you found them all yet? Well, there's no need to rush. They say there are many poison spiders near the Altar of Passage of the Dark Elves.

Q00324_SweetestVenom/30351-04.htm.text: Astaron: While travelling southwest from the village, you will encounter the Altar of Passage of the Dark Elves. There are many poison spiders living in the nearby woods. Hunt the spiders and bring me their Poison Sacs. If you bring me ten Poison Sacs , I will reward you generously.
